description: Center-star multiple sequence alignment of a multi-FASTA input (a Clustal alignment is read too) — nucleotide or protein, detected from the records and reported as `type` — with consensus and per-column conservation.

input.description: Two or more sequences in multi-FASTA format (>name / sequence) or as a Clustal alignment, nucleotide or protein. Up to 100 are aligned.

name: multiple_sequence_alignment
title: Multiple Sequence Alignment
